name: Chimichurri Flank Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar (or apple cider vinegar)
why: Solid mid-band on published numbers (538 cal, 3g carbs, 37g protein) and structurally low-carb: whole-muscle beef + herb/oil sauce, no starch base. Distinct dish from the two flank steaks already accepted this run (parmesan-green-beans, provolone-rolls). Scales cleanly to 14 (sear more steak, blend more sauce, weigh-and-divide). Flank steak has NO board home (board carries sirloin/ribeye/chuck) - flagged as a deliberate pricer-lane test candidate.
